nodes.name: intro / intros
nodes.description: Introduces hypotheses and universal quantifiers into local context

nodes.name: rcases / obtain
nodes.description: Recursive case analysis and destructuring of conjunctions and existentials

nodes.name: induction
nodes.description: Applies structural or well-founded induction principle to inductive data

nodes.name: simp
nodes.description: General term rewriting engine using equational lemmas and simp-sets

nodes.name: simp only
nodes.description: Deterministic simplification using strictly enumerated equational lemmas

nodes.name: omega
nodes.description: Presburger arithmetic decision procedure for Nat and Int linear constraints

nodes.name: ring
nodes.description: Polynomial ring equality normalizer modulo commutative ring axioms

nodes.name: exact
nodes.description: Closes the active goal immediately with an exact term match

nodes.name: apply
nodes.description: Matches lemma conclusion against goal and generates subgoals for premises

nodes.name: grind
nodes.description: Lean 4 modern heuristic automated theorem search tactic

triplets.condition: General simp explodes AST size, loops, or introduces inaccessible daggers
triplets.guidance: Harvest minimal required lemma set from squeeze_simp or plainGoal diagnostics and restrict to simp only [lemmas].
triplets.pitfalls: Unbounded simp slows down compilation and degrades maintenance stability across Lean versions.

triplets.condition: Introduced hypothesis is a composite structure, existential, or conjunction
triplets.guidance: Immediately destructure compound hypotheses into named components using obtain or rcases.
triplets.pitfalls: Leaving existential hypotheses in un-destructured form requires repeated projection extraction.

triplets.condition: Base case of natural number induction yields linear arithmetic equality
triplets.guidance: Close the zero/base case directly with omega before elaborating inductive step.
triplets.pitfalls: Elaborating verbose manual rewrites on trivial base cases bloats proof scripts.

triplets.condition: Subterm or lemma already matches goal completely without remaining premises
triplets.guidance: Prefer exact over apply to prevent lingering metavariables or unintended subgoals.
triplets.pitfalls: Using apply when exact fits can leave invisible typeclass synthesis goals open.

triplets.condition: Goal involves multiplication of variables rather than pure linear inequalities
triplets.guidance: Use ring for non-linear algebraic ring identities where omega decision procedure fails.
triplets.pitfalls: Omega rejects non-linear multiplication terms, causing premature tactic failure.

triplets.condition: First-order goal simplification before deep combinatorial search
triplets.guidance: Pre-normalize the goal state using simp only before dispatching to grind.
triplets.pitfalls: Dispatching grind directly to unsimplified goals causes heartbeat exhaustion.
